fields.name: Dr. Ananya Iyer
fields.bio: Anxiety and adolescent specialist. I blend cognitive behavioural therapy with mindfulness to help teenagers and young adults manage panic, worry and exam stress. Sessions are warm, structured and judgement free.

fields.name: Rohan Mehta
fields.bio: I work with couples and individuals navigating relationship conflict, communication breakdowns and work-related stress. My approach is emotionally focused and practical, with clear tools you can use at home.

fields.name: Dr. Priya Nair
fields.bio: Trauma-informed therapist trained in EMDR. I support adults recovering from depression, grief and past trauma, and I help clients rebuild a sense of safety and self-trust at their own pace.

fields.name: Arjun Deshpande
fields.bio: ADHD and academic-stress coach for students and young professionals. I teach executive-function strategies, focus routines and self-compassion so that attention difficulties stop running your life.

fields.name: Dr. Meera Krishnan
fields.bio: Consultant psychiatrist offering medication review alongside therapy for bipolar disorder, severe anxiety and sleep problems. I coordinate closely with psychologists for integrated, whole-person care.

fields.name: Kavya Rao
fields.bio: Compassion-focused counsellor helping people through grief, low self-esteem and burnout. I weave mindfulness and value-based goal setting into every session so change feels sustainable.

fields.name: Dr. Vikram Sharma
fields.bio: I specialise in addiction recovery and men's mental health, including anger, identity and fatherhood challenges. Recovery is built on accountability without shame, and family involvement where helpful.

fields.name: Sneha Pillai
fields.bio: Child psychologist supporting autism, developmental delays and parenting stress. I use play-based and behavioural techniques, and I coach parents so progress continues between sessions.
